system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Fortitude, Intermediate Presence. This legendary Discipline renders the user immovable, always active at no cost. She cannot be knocked off her feet, forced back, or otherwise physically displaced by anything short of Final Death; attacks still deal full damage, and additional Fortitude may reduce it until she reaches Incapacitated (at which point she can only bid Stamina-related Traits, but remains standing until torpor or Final Death). It does not protect against wholly overwhelming impacts such as a speeding train or crashing airplane, which still destroy the user outright, and using it often risks a Masquerade breach. Any witness who sees the display grants the user a free retest on Intimidation or Leadership tests for the remainder of the scene.

Costs 8 Experience Traits to learn.
